title: Engineering Nanodiamonds for Quantum Sensing: Material Constraints at the Nanoscale
summary: Optically addressable solid-state spin defects have emerged as powerful multimodal quantum sensors, with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in bulk diamond providing benchmark quantum control and sensitivity under ambient conditions. Embedding such defects in nanodiamonds (NDs) extends these capabilities to mobile probes capable of accessing complex biological and nanoscale environments.
